response.sql: WITH j AS (SELECT o.mktnote AS mk, (f.feerate - f.rebrate) AS net FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = f.orderslink), overall AS (SELECT AVG(net) AS oa FROM j), g AS (SELECT mk, AVG(net) AS ga FROM j GROUP BY mk) SELECT AVG(g.ga) AS mean_avg_net_fee_rate, AVG(g.ga - overall.oa) AS mean_excess FROM g, overall WHERE overall.oa IS NOT NULL AND g.ga > overall.oa
